realness.note: a long file's p_real is the mean of its window probabilities; its verdict uses file-level thresholds lo 0.4 / hi 0.77 read from held-out long files (119 files, only 23 synthesized: weak calibration). Each window is calibrated on held-out 4 s clips (lo 0.17 / hi 0.77). Windows find stretches made entirely of code synthesis; a code-made layer under a louder real mix is usually missed, so judge the source files and stems too. It hears how a sound sounds, not where it came from (clean pro-synthesized UI tones read as code-synthesized): see eval/realness/RESULTS.md
